summary: Set your td battle strategy at the frontiers. Lead epic towers & mighty heroes
description:
Ironhide’s epic td battles are back! Discover an action-packed offline tower defense game, Kingdom Rush Frontiers! Defend the kingdom in explosive tower defense battles with epic heroes and mighty defense towers! Rush into diverse td battles in different landscapes in an offline game full of wild enemies and unpredictable challenges. It’s up to you to defend the frontiers of the kingdom! In Kingdom Rush Frontiers, new uprising heroes will challenge their enemies as they defend an exotic realm from dragons, man-eating plants and ghastly underworld denizens. What is an epic action game without flashy defense towers, fast levels, mighty heroes, action-packed td battles & boss fights? Rule the battlefield on the frontiers with Kingdom Rush’s signature battle towers! Thought for strategy game fans & newcomers to the genre alike, Kingdom Rush Frontiers is one of those fast offline td strategy games that will challenge your tower defense strategy and your heroes’ epic power in new, challenging ways!

BUILD MIGHTY TOWERS & LEAD EPIC TD BATTLES!

• OVER 18 TOWER ABILITIES! Unleash them to rule the battlefield. clash with hordes of different enemies in intense tower defense battles! • 8 SPECIALIZED TOWER UPGRADES! Conquer victory with Crossbow Forts, Mighty Templars, Necromancers… Each tower has a special strategic value! • UPGRADE SYSTEM min/max your towers’ defense towards your preferred battle strategy. • Fight dragons and epic enemies in the kingdom’s unexplored frontiers - set your towers in deserts, jungles, and even the underworld!

TRAIN LEGENDARY HEROES

• 16 LEGENDARY HEROES. Choose among mighty champions and train their abilities! Each one has unique skills to help you beat every challenge in the realm! • Discover special features on every stage! Beware the Black Dragon!

DEFEAT THEM ALL IN FAST OFFLINE TOWER DEFENSE BATTLES

• OVER 40 DIVERSE KINGDOM ENEMIES with epic and unique abilities! Beat them as you rush through desert sandworms, tribal shamans, nomad tribes & underground terrors. • EPIC TD BOSS FIGHTS! Get those battle upgrades to claim victory!

MORE MIND-BOGGLING CONTENT

• Hours of gameplay with 80+ OFFLINE ACHIEVEMENTS! what can you expect from Ironhide, Kingdom Rush creators? Search for Easter eggs and fight for epic campaign achievements in the kingdom’s wildest strategy games and challenges! • IT’S AN OFFLINE GAME! No internet? No problem! Jump into real offline realm action! • IN-GAME STORY ENCYCLOPEDIA! learn all about this strategy game, your towers, enemies and plan the best strategy to clash them. Study up to rule this offline game! • CLASSIC, IRON, AND HEROIC TD GAME MODES to challenge your tactical skills to clash your enemies! • 3 DIFFICULTY MODES! Are you up for an epic challenge? Try Hard mode in the battlefield and play a fast offline game! ----------------------------------------------------- PRAISE FOR KINGDOM RUSH FRONTIERS: IGN Editor's Choice, Slide To Play Must Have, 148 Apps Editor's Choice, Jay is Games Game of the Year, Pocket Gamer Gold Award, Touch Arcade 4.5/5 Ironhide games’ Terms and Conditions: https://www.ironhidegames.com/TermsOfService Ironhide’s Privacy Policy: https://www.ironhidegames.com/PrivacyPolicy Video/podcast creators & streamers: We love to see your content on Youtube, Tiktok and Twitch!
